dominant_strengths: Clear information hierarchy with bold section header, subdued date, and tidy stat triplet that reads instantly at a glance
Restrained color system uses hue (red/yellow/green circles) semantically for priority, integrated cleanly with neutral grays
Tag pills and meta rows are consistently sized and aligned, showing genuine attention to spacing rhythm and grouping
dominant_weaknesses: Visually generic Todoist/Things lookalike — almost no distinctive idea separates this from a hundred other task apps
Progress bar at bottom of Today card feels orphaned and unlabeled, and the '2/9' counter mismatches the 5-item visible list
Emotional warmth is low; layout is competent but cold, with no moments of delight, illustration, or personality
fix_priorities: Introduce one signature element (timeline, focus mode, smart grouping) to escape me-too territory
Reconcile counters — '2/9' progress, '5' Today badge, and three stat tiles tell inconsistent stories
Add subtle texture or accent (illustrated empty states, micro-interactions) to lift emotional resonance
rationale.norman_balance: Strong behavioral clarity and decent visceral polish, but reflective layer is thin — nothing here makes a user feel ownership or pride.
rationale.intent_fit: Solidly executes a task-list brief with legible structure, but 'improved' is unconvincing without a distinctive interaction or organizational concept.
